title: AddGroupRequest
description: Request for add_group. permitted_actions and pkps are keccak256 hashes as hex strings (with or without 0x). API key via header.

group_name.description: Name of the group (Group.metadata.name in AccountConfig.sol).

group_description.description: Description of the group (Group.metadata.description in AccountConfig.sol).

pkp_ids_permitted.description: pkp ids permitted to use the group (AccountConfig.sol Group.pkpId).

cid_hashes_permitted.description: Actions permitted to use the group (AccountConfig.sol Group.cidHash).
